meta.description: Persistence of a fraud report or fraud de-marking for a credit card authorization transaction in the fraud database.
meta.process_description: The program receives an authorization message with a fraud status indicator (report fraud or remove fraud) and writes it to the fraud table AUTHFRDS. All relevant transaction data (card number, merchant information, amounts, authorization codes) are stored together with the fraud status and the current reporting date. If an entry already exists for the same card and the same authorization timestamp (duplicate error -803), the existing record is updated with the new fraud status and the current date instead of being newly created. The program returns a success or error message to the calling program (COPAUS1C) via the Communication Area.

files.CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS: Fraud database table that persists reported or de-flagged fraudulent credit card authorization transactions with all transaction and merchant details as well as the fraud status
files.CIPAUDTY: Copybook containing the data structure of an authorization message (card number, authorization details, merchant data, amounts, transaction ID)
files.AUTHFRDS: SQL include containing the host variable structure for the DB2 table CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS

business_rules: A transaction can either be flagged as fraudulent ('F') or an existing fraud report can be withdrawn ('R') – both actions are permanently logged in the fraud database.
If a fraud entry already exists for a card number and an authorization timestamp, it is updated (no duplicate) to allow status changes (e.g., fraud → no fraud).
The report date is always set to the current system date to document the point in time of the fraud decision in an audit-proof manner.
The authorization timestamp is reconstructed from a compressed time format of the original message (999999999 minus time value) and stored as a readable timestamp.
All relevant transaction data (merchant, amount, authorization code, POS entry mode, country code) are stored together with the fraud report to ensure complete fraud documentation.
The program is a pure service component with no user interface of its own – it is called exclusively by COPAUS1C (detail view) and returns the result via the COMMAREA.

variables.name: WS-VARIABLES
variables.description: Top-level group structure for all internal working variables of program COPAUS2C required for processing the fraud report.

variables.name: WS-PGMNAME
variables.description: Internal program name used to identify the module in error logs and system calls. Enables unambiguous assignment of error messages to this service component.

variables.name: WS-LENGTH
variables.description: Length field for CICS communication calls, e.g. for passing the COMMAREA length when called by COPAUS1C. Required for correct data transfer between programs.

variables.name: WS-AUTH-TIME
variables.description: Calculated authorization timestamp as a numeric value reconstructed from the compressed time field of the original message (999999999 minus PA-AUTH-TIME-9C). Serves as an intermediate value for conversion into the readable timestamp WS-AUTH-TS.

variables.name: WS-AUTH-TIME-AN
variables.description: Alphanumeric view of the calculated authorization timestamp. Enables character-by-character access to the individual time components (hours, minutes, seconds) in order to transfer them into the formatted timestamp structure WS-AUTH-TS.

variables.name: WS-AUTH-TS
variables.description: Complete, human-readable authorization timestamp in the format 'YY-MM-DD HH.MI.SS.SSS', stored as the unique transaction key in the fraud database CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS. Enables audit-proof assignment of the fraud report to the exact original transaction.

variables.name: WS-AUTH-YY
variables.description: Two-digit year of the authorization timestamp, e.g. '24' for 2024. Part of the composite timestamp for unique identification of the original transaction in the fraud database.

variables.name: FILLER
variables.description: Separator '-' between year and month in the authorization timestamp. Ensures the human-readable date format 'YY-MM-DD' in the stored timestamp.

variables.name: WS-AUTH-MM
variables.description: Two-digit month of the authorization timestamp, e.g. '03' for March. Part of the composite timestamp for unique identification of the original transaction in the fraud database.

variables.name: FILLER
variables.description: Separator '-' between month and day in the authorization timestamp. Ensures the human-readable date format 'YY-MM-DD' in the stored timestamp.

variables.name: WS-AUTH-DD
variables.description: Two-digit day of the authorization timestamp, e.g. '15'. Part of the composite timestamp for unique identification of the original transaction in the fraud database.

variables.name: FILLER
variables.description: Space character as separator between the date and time portions of the authorization timestamp. Separates 'YY-MM-DD' from 'HH.MI.SS' for human-readable representation.

variables.name: WS-AUTH-HH
variables.description: Two-digit hour (24h format) of the authorization timestamp, e.g. '14'. Enables precise temporal classification of the transaction for fraud documentation.

variables.name: FILLER
variables.description: Separator '.' between hours and minutes in the time portion of the authorization timestamp. Conforms to the DB2 timestamp format 'HH.MI.SS'.

variables.name: WS-AUTH-MI
variables.description: Two-digit minute of the authorization timestamp, e.g. '32'. Part of the precise timestamp for audit-proof documentation of the exact transaction time.

variables.name: FILLER
variables.description: Separator '.' between minutes and seconds in the time portion of the authorization timestamp. Conforms to the DB2 timestamp format 'HH.MI.SS'.

variables.name: WS-AUTH-SS
variables.description: Two-digit second of the authorization timestamp, e.g. '47'. Together with the milliseconds, enables second-precise identification of the transaction as a unique key in the fraud database.

variables.name: WS-AUTH-SSS
variables.description: Three-digit milliseconds of the authorization timestamp. Increases the uniqueness of the timestamp as a key in the fraud database to avoid collisions for transactions occurring within the same second.

variables.name: FILLER
variables.description: Padding value '000' for the microseconds portion of the DB2 timestamp. Since the original message does not supply microseconds, this portion is fixed at zero to satisfy the complete DB2 timestamp format.

variables.name: WS-ERR-FLG
variables.description: Error indicator for processing control: indicates whether an error occurred during the database operation. Controls the subsequent program flow and the response returned to the calling program COPAUS1C.

variables.name: ERR-FLG-ON
variables.description: Condition name: signals that an error occurred while persisting the fraud report. Triggers error handling and causes an error status to be returned to COPAUS1C.

variables.name: ERR-FLG-OF
variables.description: Condition name: signals that the database operation completed without errors. Enables a success status ('ADD SUCCESS' or 'UPDT SUCCESS') to be returned to the calling program COPAUS1C.

variables.name: WS-SQLCODE
variables.description: Formatted DB2 return code for logging and error message purposes. Contains the SQLCODE as a human-readable signed value so that a meaningful error message can be returned to COPAUS1C in the event of an error (e.g. -803 for a duplicate entry).

variables.name: WS-SQLSTATE
variables.description: Formatted DB2 SQLSTATE code for extended error diagnosis. Supplements the SQLCODE with a standardized status code that assists in analyzing errors from the database operation (INSERT/UPDATE in CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS).

variables.name: WS-ABS-TIME
variables.description: Absolute system timestamp retrieved via CICS ASKTIME. Serves as the basis for determining the current system date (WS-CUR-DATE), which is stored audit-proof in the database as the fraud report date (PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE).

variables.name: WS-CUR-DATE
variables.description: Current system date at the time of the fraud report in the format YYYYMMDD. Stored as the fraud report date in the database to document the exact point in time of the fraud decision in an audit-proof manner.

variables.name: DFHCOMMAREA
variables.description: CICS communication area for data exchange between the calling program COPAUS1C (detail view) and this service component. Contains all input and output data of the fraud report: account data, transaction data, and the result of the database operation.

variables.name: WS-ACCT-ID
variables.description: Account number of the affected credit card account. Stored together with the card number and the authorization timestamp to uniquely identify the fraudulent transaction in the fraud database CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS.

variables.name: WS-CUST-ID
variables.description: Customer number of the cardholder whose transaction is being reported as fraudulent or unmarked. Stored in the fraud database to assign the complete fraud documentation to the correct customer.

variables.name: WS-FRAUD-AUTH-RECORD
variables.description: Group structure containing all transaction data of the authorization transaction to be reported or unmarked (included via COPY CIPAUDTY). Provides merchant data, amount, card number, and authorization details for complete fraud documentation in CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS.

variables.name: WS-FRAUD-STATUS-RECORD
variables.description: Group structure for controlling and returning the result of the fraud action. Contains the requested action (report or withdraw), the result of the database operation, and a business-level response to COPAUS1C.

variables.name: WS-FRD-ACTION
variables.description: Control field for the requested fraud action, set by COPAUS1C: 'F' = report the transaction as fraudulent in CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS, 'R' = withdraw an existing fraud report. Determines which fraud indicator is stored in the database.

variables.name: WS-REPORT-FRAUD
variables.description: Condition name: signals that the transaction is to be reported as fraudulent. Triggers an INSERT or UPDATE in CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS with the fraud indicator 'F'.

variables.name: WS-REMOVE-FRAUD
variables.description: Condition name: signals that an existing fraud report is to be withdrawn. Triggers an UPDATE in CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS with the indicator 'R' to correct the fraud status of the transaction.

variables.name: WS-FRD-UPDATE-STATUS
variables.description: Result status of the database operation returned to COPAUS1C after persistence: 'S' = fraud report successfully saved or updated, 'F' = database operation failed. Enables COPAUS1C to provide the correct feedback to the clerk.

variables.name: WS-FRD-UPDT-SUCCESS
variables.description: Condition name: signals that the fraud report or unmarking was successfully persisted in CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS. Results in the response 'ADD SUCCESS' (new record) or 'UPDT SUCCESS' (update) being returned to COPAUS1C.

variables.name: WS-FRD-UPDT-FAILED
variables.description: Condition name: signals that the database operation failed. Results in an error description being returned to COPAUS1C so that the clerk is informed of the failure of the fraud report.

variables.name: WS-FRD-ACT-MSG
variables.description: Plain-text business response to the calling program COPAUS1C, e.g. 'ADD SUCCESS' for a successful new record, 'UPDT SUCCESS' for a successful update, or an error description including the SQLCODE for a failed database operation. Used to display the processing result to the clerk.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.description: MAIN-PARA controls the complete flow of fraud persistence: it determines the current reporting date, reconstructs the authorization timestamp, populates the fraud record with all transaction details, and writes it to the fraud database – with automatic update if an entry already exists.

paragraphs.name: FRAUD-UPDATE
paragraphs.description: Updates an existing fraud entry in the fraud database with the new fraud status and the current reporting date. This paragraph is called when a record already exists for the relevant card and authorization timestamp (duplicate case).
